wholePhysicalScope: Native way 131997214 follows the standing chapel footprint, including the sacristy and polygonal apse. Small variation in long surveyed wall lines is represented by the mean nave wall planes.
lodDetails: Four authored levels preserve the gable, south lancets, west trifora, polygonal apse and belfry.
limitations: Visible exterior only. The frescoed interior, separate Roman arena, removed portico and palace, and unrelated visitor buildings are outside the model scope.

Intermediate heights, brick colors, west window stone tracery, belfry fittings and small sacristy details are approximations. No historically conjectural portico or exterior frescoes are reconstructed.
